headlines.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to allow White House ballroom construction to continue
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump on Friday asked the Supreme Court to allow him to continue construction of a sprawling ballroom adjacent to the White House.

headlines.title: FBI reports record decrease in violent crime in 2025
headlines.description: Statistics released Friday by the FBI showed record declines last year in the national estimated violent crime rate and the estimated rate for murders and certain manslaughters.

headlines.title: Trump says he will soon declare the Strait of Hormuz a U.S. territory
headlines.description: The war in Iran continues on as Vice President Vance says the new goal is to keep costs down for Americans and President Trump disputes reports about mental health issues on deployed ships. NBC’s Monica Alba, Keir Simmons and Gordon Lubold bring their latest reporting on the war to the table.

headlines.title: Trump-Picked Kennedy Center Board Votes to Add Trump's Name
headlines.description: The board of the Kennedy Center, appointed by President Trump, voted Thursday to add Trump’s name back to the building’s facade. They also voted to close the main building for renovations for two years, keeping only a small portion open.

headlines.title: USS Lincoln to Be Replaced After Record 9 Months in Middle East
headlines.description: There are mounting concerns from lawmakers and military families over conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln which is on a record deployment in the Middle East. While the Pentagon and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth are downplaying concerns, another aircraft carrier is now on its way to the region to replace the Lincoln. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Trump dismisses concerns from families about grim conditions aboard USS Lincoln
headlines.description: President Donald Trump on Friday dismissed concerns from families of service members about the grim conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, whose deployment had been overextended in the Middle East due to the Iran war.

headlines.title: Woman arrested and facing felony charges in World War II Memorial vandalism case, DOJ says
headlines.description: A woman accused of vandalizing the World War II Memorial has been arrested in Washington, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro announced Friday.

headlines.title: Judge shows signs of frustration with DOJ attorneys over handling of Epstein files
headlines.description: The judge said he had “absolutely no desire” to go down the road of holding government attorneys in contempt but gave a history lesson on when he has done so.

headlines.title: Appeals court dodges major ruling on Trump’s contentious use of obscure deportation law
headlines.description: The case focuses on last year’s attempted removal of alleged Tren de Aragua gang members using the 18th century Alien Enemies Act.

headlines.title: The Constitution at a standstill: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, NBC News reporters dig into the impact of the Iran war on the economy at home and also on U.S. forces deployed in the region.

headlines.title: Kennedy Center board votes to add president’s name again — and throw in a ‘Trump Plaza’
headlines.description: The board also voted to close the center’s main building for renovations while keeping a smaller addition open in response to a court order.
